'''Sergio Focardi''' (1932 &ndash; 22 June 2013) was an Italian [[physicist]] and [[professor]] [[emeritus]] at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>http://www.magazine.unibo.it/Magazine/Notizie/2013/06/24/Lutto_in_Ateneo.htm Lutto in Ateneo: è scomparso Sergio Focardi (tr. ''Mourning at the University: Sergio Focardi is passed away'')</ref><ref>https://www.affaritaliani.it/culturaspettacoli/morto-fisico-italiano-sergio-focardi.html E' morto il grande fisico italiano Sergio Focardi (tr. ''Great Italian physicist Sergio Focardi is dead'') Retrieved 15 September 2015</ref><ref>[http://www.df.unibo.it/personale/prof_emeriti.htm Professori Emeriti]. Department of Physics, [[University of Bologna]]. Retrieved 16 November 2011.  {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110421061602/http://www.df.unibo.it/personale/prof_emeriti.htm |date=April 21, 2011 }}</ref>
He led the Department of Bologna of the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare|(Italian) National Institute for Nuclear Physics]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tecnosophia.org/documenti/Articoli/SessioneI/Focardi.pdf |accessdate=November 1, 2011 |url-status=dead |title=PRODUZIONE DI ENERGIA E REAZIONI NUCLEARI IN SISTEMI NI-H A 400 C  |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113103231/http://www.tecnosophia.org/documenti/Articoli/SessioneI/Focardi.pdf |archivedate=January 13, 2012 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.magazine.unibo.it/Magazine/Notizie/2006/04/26/emeriti.htm Dieci professori dell’Alma Mater diventano "emeriti"]. 26 April 2006. Retrieved 15 September 2015</ref> and the [[Faculty (division)|Faculty]] of Mathematical, Physical and Natural Sciences at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>Ilaria Venturi. [http://bologna.repubblica.it/cronaca/2011/01/14/news/fusione_nucleare_a_freddo_a_bologna_ci_siamo_riusciti-11237521/ Fusione nucleare a freddo "A Bologna ci siamo riusciti"] Sergio Focardi, professore emerito dell'Alma Mater, fisico di calibro, in passato preside della facoltà di Scienze. 14 January 2011. Retrieved 15 September 2015</ref><ref>[http://radio.rcdc.it/archives/e-morto-il-fisico-sergio-focardi-padre-della-fusione-fredda-ni-h-121187/ Preside fino al 1990 della facoltà di scienze matematiche, fisiche e naturali dell’Università di Bologna] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131109004218/http://radio.rcdc.it/archives/e-morto-il-fisico-sergio-focardi-padre-della-fusione-fredda-ni-h-121187/ |date=2013-11-09 }} 24 June 2013.</ref>

In the early 1960s Focardi spent time at [[CERN]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://inspirehep.net/search?p=1382905+or+1341834&f=recid |title=Sergio Focardi's CERN-affiliated scientific papers |website=Inspire-HEP |publisher=CERN |access-date= September 26, 2017}}</ref> in [[Geneva]].

He was a member of the President's Board of the [[Italian Physical Society]].<ref>[http://prometeo.sif.it/papers/online/sag/report2010/report-2010.pdf ''Resoconto Annuale, Delle Attivitia 2010''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120403000218/http://prometeo.sif.it/papers/online/sag/report2010/report-2010.pdf |date=2012-04-03 }}. [[Italian Physical Society|Società Italiana di Fisica]], page 3.<br>Presidente
Luisa CIFARELLI<br>
Consiglio di Presidenza (President's Board)<br>
Alessandro BETTINI<br> 
Simonetta CROCI<br>
Enzo DE SANCTIS (VicePresidente)<br>
Sergio FOCARDI<br>
Vincenzo GRASSO (segretario Cassiere)<br>
Guido PIRAGINO<br>
Angiolino STELLA<br></ref>
From 1992 he had been working on [[cold fusion]] with [[nickel]]-[[hydrogen]] reactors.<ref>Franco, Foresta Martin. [http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/1994/febbraio/20/fusione_fredda_alla_senese_accende_co_0_94022011712.shtml "la fusione fredda alla senese accende di nuovo la speranza"]. ''[[Corriere della Sera]],'' 20 February 1994, page 31.</ref> From 2007 until his death, Focardi collaborated with inventor [[Andrea Rossi (entrepreneur)|Andrea Rossi]] on the development of the [[Energy Catalyzer]] (E-Cat).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://oilprice.com/Interviews/The-Limitless-Potential-of-the-E-Cat-An-Interview-with-Andrea-Rossi.html |title=The Limitless Potential of the E-Cat: An Interview with Andrea Ross i|accessdate=15 September 2015 |author=James Burgess |date=29 March 2012}}</ref><ref>Mats Lewan. [http://www.nyteknik.se/nyheter/energi_miljo/energi/article3347150.ece Swedish physicists run the site Ecat.com] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140802014544/http://www.nyteknik.se/nyheter/energi_miljo/energi/article3347150.ece |date=2014-08-02 }}. ''Ny Teknik''. 18 November 2011</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.eetimes.com/electronics-news/4212428/Italian-scientists-claim-cold-fusion-success |title=Peter Clarke |access-date=2012-09-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110821060830/http://www.eetimes.com/electronics-news/4212428/Italian-scientists-claim-cold-fusion-success |archive-date=2011-08-21 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>Fabio Deotto. [https://daily.wired.it/news/scienza/fusione-fredda-bologna.html Fusione fredda realizzata a Bologna. Sarà vero?] [[Wired (magazine)|Wired]], Italian edition. 19 January 2011. Retrieved 15 September 2015.</ref>

== Studies on nickel-hydrogen exothermal systems ==
[[File:Piantelli Focardi schema reattore 01 it.jpg|thumb|300px|right|Diagram of the reactor devised by Focardi ''et al.''<ref name=Piantelli-Focardi-ProdEnerNiH400C>Focardi S, Piantelli F. [http://www.tecnosophia.org/documenti/Articoli/SessioneI/Focardi.pdf ''Produzione di energia e reazioni nucleari in sistemi Ni-H a 400 C''] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113103231/http://www.tecnosophia.org/documenti/Articoli/SessioneI/Focardi.pdf |date=2012-01-13 }}. [[Università di Bologna]], [http://www.christinasponza.it/christinasponza.it/speciale_nucleare/notizie_articoli/2005_04_18-19_convegno_bologna/2005_04_18-19_convegno_bologna.htm Conferenza nazionale sulla politica energetica in Italia] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120325021059/http://www.christinasponza.it/christinasponza.it/speciale_nucleare/notizie_articoli/2005_04_18-19_convegno_bologna/2005_04_18-19_convegno_bologna.htm |date=2012-03-25 }}, Bologna (18–19 April 2005).</ref>]]

In the early 90s Sergio Focardi, together with physicists Roberto Habel and [[Francesco Piantelli]], started to develop a nickel-hydrogen exothermal reactor. The results of their research were presented in 1994,<ref>[http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/1994/febbraio/19/Siena_scopre_energia_pulita_Fusione_co_0_94021911463.shtml "Siena scopre l' energia pulita Fusione fredda all' italiana?"] ''[[Corriere della Sera]],'' 19 February 1994, page 12.</ref><ref name=Piantelli-Focardi-Corriere-19940220>Franco, Foresta Martin. [http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/1994/febbraio/20/fusione_fredda_alla_senese_accende_co_0_94022011712.shtml "La fusione fredda alla senese accende di nuovo la speranza"]. ''[[Corriere della Sera]],'' 20 February 1994.</ref> and published on the [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] ''[[Il Nuovo Cimento A]]''.<ref>[http://www.adnkronos.com/Archivio/AdnAgenzia/1994/02/17/Scienza/FUSIONE-FREDDA-ESPERIMENTO-A-SIENA-INTERESSE-INDUSTRIA-USA_191200.php Fusione Fredda: esperimento a siena, interesse industria USA] ''[[Adnkronos]]'', 17 February 1994.</ref><ref>Franco Prattico. [https://ricerca.repubblica.it/repubblica/archivio/repubblica/1994/02/18/la-bomba-di-siena.html?ref=search La ' Bomba' di Siena] ''[[La Repubblica]]'', 18 February 1994.</ref><ref>[http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/1994/febbraio/19/Siena_scopre_energia_pulita_Fusione_co_0_94021911463.shtml Oggi il grande annuncio dell’ Universita’ Toscana] ''[[Corriere della Sera]]'', 19 February 1994. Retrieved 15 September 2015.</ref><ref>[http://www.radiocittadelcapo.it/archives/stremmenos-la-fusione-fredda-puo-risolvere-molti-problemi-dellumanita-77206/ Stremmenos: “la fusione fredda risolverà molti problemi dell’umanità”] ''[[:it:Radio Città del Capo|Radio Città del Capo]]'', 25 April 2011.</ref><ref>Focardi S, Habel R, Piantelli F (January 1994). "Anomalous Heat Production in Ni-H Systems" ''[[Il Nuovo Cimento A]],'' Volume 107 A, Number 1, 163–167.</ref><ref name=Focardi_1998>{{cite journal |title=Large excess heat production in Ni-H systems |author1=Focardi S |author2=Gabbani V |author3=Montalbano V |author4=Piantelli F |author5=Veronesi S |journal=[[Il Nuovo Cimento A]] |date=November 1998 |volume=111 |issue=11 |pages=1233–1242 |doi=10.1007/BF03545791 |oclc=204819206|bibcode=1998NCimA.111.1233F |s2cid=14916904 }}</ref><ref>Battaglia, Daddi, Focardi, Gabbani, Montalbano, Piantelli, Sona, Veronesi. [https://doi.org/10.1007%2FBF03035901 Neutron emission in Ni-H systems]. ''[[Il Nuovo Cimento A]]'' (1971-1996), Volume 112, Number 9, 921–931. Retrieved on [[SpringerLink]].</ref>
